title: 2MB macOS app.bin committed to the repo in the head commit
evidence: git ls-files | grep app.bin -> "app.bin"; git show 0118cc0 --stat | grep app.bin -> "app.bin | Bin 0 -> 2057480 bytes"; .gitignore contains "bin/" and "tools/raylib-sw/" but NOT "app.bin"
detail: A platform-specific 2MB build artifact is tracked; README documents it as build output ('odin build app # produce the binary'). Bloats the repo and pins one OS/arch binary into history.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached app.bin, add 'app.bin' to .gitignore, and rebuild locally when playing (as README already instructs).

title: 'map bare' fixture can never pass its own replay gate — fixture flag hardcoded false
evidence: line 118-120: "bar := false", "_ = bar", "replayed, ok := replay_hashes(log_path, catalogs, u64(len(live_hashes)), false, &fails)"; line 155: "replayed, ok := replay_hashes(log_path, catalogs, u64(man.ticks), false, &fails)" — while harness/main.odin run_demo branches "if demo.map_fixture == \"bare\" { prun.run_context_create_bare(&rc, demo.seed, catalogs) }". Empirically: blessed a demo with 'map bare', ran 'harness run bare_test' -> "replay FIRST DIVERGENCE at tick 1: dce792328428e870 != 3e7eeae01dcbc129" / "replay of the blessed log diverges from the manifest"
detail: parse_demo and run_demo both support the documented bare fixture, but verify_replay/run_replay always replay with the default 6-node bootstrap map, so any bare demo spuriously FAILs its ODN-11 gate. The dead 'bar := false; _ = bar' lines show the flag was left unthreaded.
recommended_fix: Record the fixture in the T1 manifest header (or read the demo file in run_replay) and pass the real bare flag through verify_replay/replay_hashes; delete the dead bar variable.

title: 'demolish node' without a name panics with index-out-of-range instead of a parse error
evidence: line 143-146: "case \"demolish\":", "if len(fields) < 2 { return it, fmt.tprintf(\"line %d: demolish a-b|node name\", ln) }", "if fields[1] == \"node\" {", "it.verb = \"demolish_node\"" followed by "it.a = strings.clone(fields[2])". Empirically, 'at 100ms demolish node' -> runtime panic: "harness/demo_parse.odin(147:32) Index 2 is out of range 0..<2"
detail: len(fields)==2 passes the guard, then fields[2] is read out of bounds. A typo'd demo aborts the ENTIRE harness run (all remaining demos skipped) instead of failing that one demo loudly — violating the strict-parse contract stated in the file header.
recommended_fix: Require len(fields) >= 3 for the 'node' form and return the existing 'demolish a-b|node name' parse error otherwise.

title: diff.json omits first_divergent_tick and event_stream_delta promised by §10.5
evidence: line 157: "js := fmt.tprintf(`{{\"frame_ms\": %d, \"mismatched_pixels\": %d, \"total_pixels\": %d, \"bounding_box\": [%d, %d, %d, %d]}}`, ms, mismatch, total, bbox[0], bbox[1], bbox[2], bbox[3])" vs architecture §10.5: "diff.json # {frame, mismatched_pixels, total_pixels, bounding_box_of_change, first_divergent_tick (T1), event_stream_delta: [...]}"
detail: The T1 divergence tick does reach REPORT.txt as a fail message ('T1: STATE DIVERGENCE at tick N'), but the agent's stated entry point lacks the first-divergent-tick and event-stream delta fields, so pixel-vs-sim localization needs two files.
recommended_fix: Thread the first divergent tick (from check_hashes) and the tick's event list into save_diff_bundle and include both fields in diff.json.
